items.name: UCSD Spring 2023

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDSpring2023#26385-new-competitors).

It will take place in West Ballroom B (second floor) of [UC San Diego's Price Center](https://universitycenters.ucsd.edu/_images/visit-us-images/PC_Directories11X17FA21_FNL1.pdf).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzB5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c648f1c37642837bd6ec7ced2a03e220352f5fbb/wcc-banner.png)

items.name: JAM FMC IV 2023
items.information:
Keep in mind that this competition **DOES NOT** have typical events like 3x3, 2x2 or pyraminx. Cubers that are interested in checking out a competition are encouraged to attend another competition. You can search for a competition near you at [pnwcubing.com](https://pnwcubing.com). 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)

items.name: Bluegrass Bash 2023

venue.name: University of Louisville, Shelby Campus/Founders Union Building

items.information: This competition is going to be on the second floor of the Union Founders building on the UofL Shelby campus. You can use the stairs or elevators to get up to the second floor. There will be signs and overhead monitors directing you where to go. When you arrive there will be a table set up by the entrance where you will be able to pick your group sheet.
